invalidated_by: A material change to the reviewed source, its fixtures, or the release scope.

artifact.algorithm: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 sorted JSON file hash map, with no trailing newline.
artifact.digest_scope: Canonical instructions, license, verification reference and development cases. The review record and capability README are outside the package digest.

decision_question: Can the exact package publish as a source-only interview follow-up candidate for the Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: Guarded, unsent save with persisted readback

source_basis.source: Private user-authorized workflow distilled into synthetic cases. No originals, identities, message locators or private correspondence are distributed.

source_basis.authority: Canonical companion package placement and adjacent scope.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Separate read-only Codex contexts with role-specific prompts, a shared model family and common public-safe source. Exact model snapshot was not recorded.
The author acted as integrator and adjudicator. No reviewer had mailbox access or executed a live evaluation.

initial_reviews.finding: Conversation membership could pass as exact parent proof. The README needed an explicit source-only label.
Source workflow is distinct and useful. Exact parent, attendance and concurrent draft cases needed more precise coverage.
Reply opening might persist inherited data before inspection. Draft creation also needed a write-time guard.

concordance: Material disagreement on release of the initial digest. All three reviewers supported source-only release after rechecking the revised digest.

recheck.basis: Require message-level proof, preflight first-write and concurrency checks, attendance evidence, text fallback and explicit release limits.

falsification_hypotheses: A matching quote might override a contradictory persisted parent ID.
A per-request token might pass as a cross-writer uniqueness guard.
A positive fixture might omit exact parent evidence and safe initial fields.
test_results: Revised reference and same-thread case make the conflicting persisted ID decisive.
Revised reference and concurrent-create case require uniqueness across writers, beyond retry deduplication.
Positive case supplies exact persisted parent evidence, verified guard, safe quote and signature, and empty Bcc.
The independent disruptor reproduced the final digest and checked source-to-fixture parity, five analytical parent states and a two-writer counterexample. No source blocker survived.

decisive_evidence: The initial disagreement led to source revisions before reconsideration.
Exact persisted parent evidence takes precedence. Unknown first-write behavior or absent concurrency protection stops native writes.
The revised source and synthetic cases are structurally consistent. They establish no live behavior.
unresolved_items: Host support and correct behavior under isolated runtime and unseen holdout tests.

limitations: Public source and analytical evaluation only.
The development cases are test designs. No matched with/without-skill benchmark, automatic trigger test, live mailbox run, or unseen holdout was performed.
Installation can establish file availability only.
follow_up: Before native use, run isolated host tests for first persistence, exact parent evidence, concurrent writers and uncertain retry. Execute a protected external holdout before claiming host acceptance or uplift.
